QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] The Big Shot
QuestInfo.0: Maroni allowed you to participate in the match, but warned you about any funny business. You need to talk to Rave in #bBrawl 'n' Bash Club#k.
QuestInfo.1: Rave's distraction didn't go as planned, but Plunk gave you your opening. You need to escape to #bBrawl 'n' Bash Club Entrance#k and talk to Rave now.
QuestInfo.2: Rave said the plan failed. He told you that the device disappeared before he could even touch it.
